en.description:
FruitMerge is a unique puzzle game designed exclusively for Apple Watch, bringing you a fresh fruit-merging experience right on your wrist!


Important Note: This app can only be downloaded from the App Store on Apple Watch. Here's how:
1. Press the Digital Crown on your watch to open the app list
2. Find and open the App Store
3. Scroll to the bottom and tap [Account]
4. Find [Purchased] to download the app

Key Features

Watch Optimized Design
- Perfectly sized for Watch screen
- Optimized touch controls
- Smooth gameplay animations

Easy to Play
- Simple tap controls
- Merge matching fruits
- Create larger fruits

Casual Challenge
- Beat your high score
- Strategic merging
- Test your skills

Game Features
- Original fruit designs
- Satisfying merge effects
- Engaging gameplay

Highlights
- No internet required
- No advertisements
- Completely free

Challenge yourself with this Watch-exclusive fruit merging puzzle!

Requirements
Requires watchOS 8.0 or later
en.subtitle: Fruit Puzzle for Watch

zh.description:
FruitMerge 是一款专为 Apple Watch 打造的独特解谜游戏，让您在手表上享受全新的水果合成体验！


重要提示：本应用仅在 Apple Watch 的 App Store 中搜索和下载。具体步骤：
1. 在手表上点击数字表冠打开应用列表
2. 找到并打开 App Store
3. 滑动到最下方，点击【账户】
4. 在账户页面中找到【已购项目】即可下载


主要特点

手表优化设计
- 完美适配 Watch 屏幕
- 优化的触控体验
- 流畅的游戏动画

简单易上手
- 轻触即可操作
- 合并相同水果
- 创造更大水果

休闲挑战
- 挑战高分
- 策略性玩法
- 考验技巧

游戏特色
- 原创水果设计
- 精美合成效果
- 引人入胜的玩法

亮点特色
- 无需网络连接
- 无广告打扰
- 完全免费

在 Watch 上挑战这款独特的水果合成解谜游戏！

系统要求
需要 watchOS 8.0 或更高版本
